name: Steven D. Rhoads
bottom_line: The incumbent's biography page. His offices and the 2016 anti-BDS law check out; the $100 million tax-cut figure and the no-tax-increase record are his own characterizations with no breakdown.
findings: County Legislature service from 2015 and his Senate term are on the public record.
Nassau's 2016 anti-BDS law exists, but the "first county in the nation" claim was not confirmed.
page_issues: The home page lists issue headings with no detail.
No bill numbers, votes or sources for any record claim.
